reviewer_context: Independent delegated reviewer /root/req_gate_blind_semantic; did not author the candidate, raw scenario answers or contracts. Parent-supplied review scope only; complete original id/prompt requests and raw current38 answers were reviewed before provenance.
method: Read complete SKILL.md, evals/rubric.md and applicable requirements, risk, discovery, design, architecture, acceptance, quality, security, operations, incremental verification, parallel, practice, self-evolution and usage-feedback references. Reviewed all 38 complete raw answers against original id/prompt-only requests; made whole-answer scope/authorization, readiness, proportionality, commercial/security/release/cache judgments rather than keyword scoring. During blind verdict formation, excluded contracts body (hash only), mechanical scores, old response/report files, governance author conclusions, other reviewer conclusions and in-progress developer exercise. All 38 verdicts were fixed as pass before reading reuse-provenance.json; After that verdict freeze, read only current reuse-provenance.json for provenance/applicability: its 22 historical response digests match the reviewed raw files, each remains semantically compatible with current controls, and 16 cases are listed fresh_requested. No pass/fail verdict changed after provenance. After all verdicts were fixed, the parent disclosed an initial mechanical replay result of 33/38 and six lexical matcher additions. Under a new explicit review scope, read git diff -- evals/behavior_contracts.json only to audit those additions: recorded human decision, no independently editable copy, dependency-first/sequential shared-write handling, narrow filter cases/checks/tests, owners confirm, wait for confirmation. These accept equivalent wording in the complete reviewed answers without changing policy or forbidden patterns; regex polarity remains limited and independent semantic review is still necessary. The 38 raw digests and all case verdicts are unchanged. Rebound to the current manifest digest; original blind-review manifest digest was b0f978c56c85ab00919ff191a39aba8b87ee4e0838e88cf59fce74ab25084b3e. The parent-reported 33/38 is not a replay executed by this reviewer.
limitations: This is a fresh semantic review of 38 stored scenario answers, not 38 new v8 model executions. Current reuse-provenance declares 22 answers reused from v7.0.0 commit 8f8ecd5865a9d09c17ed24a6bace9407489928b6 and lists 16 cases as fresh_requested; all 22 declared historical response digests match the current reviewed raw files. Source commit contents and capture identity/model/harness/timestamp for the 16 fresh_requested cases were not independently authenticated. Historical answers show compatible stated controls, not current live-host behavior. No mechanical replay was run or scored by this reviewer; the parent-reported initial 33/38 was disclosed only after verdict freeze. No actual application coding, developer exercise, runtime hard-control effectiveness, production action, performance gain, deployment or release approval was assessed. Local digest binding proves file consistency only, not reviewer identity or required hosted approval.
